03_release_notes.text:
This release adds a tray icon with voice, speed and volume controls. It fixes
DOM offset clamping in the extension. It fixes TTS error storms that could
fill the log. Stale timers no longer fire after a window is closed. The
clipboard is now restored after a synthetic copy. Sentence highlighting
scrolls into view. Nothing in this release changes the settings file format.
The parity suite is unchanged.

04_plain_prose.text:
The garden looks well this year. The roses came back after the frost and the
hedge has thickened up nicely. We moved the bench to the far corner where it
catches the afternoon. The path needs weeding but it can wait. Next spring we
might put in a second bed along the fence. There is a blackbird nesting in the
ivy again. It sings from the shed roof most evenings. The apples should be
ready by the end of the month.
